role: Builds the world a 1.7.10 server holds before its first tick from the seed alone: the WorldServers' Det seeder draws in Java order, createSpawnPosition's biome search and fuzz loop, initialWorldChunkLoad's 625 chunk loads with Chunk.populateChunk's four-neighbour rule, each dimension's populate body (overworld, Nether, End), performWorldGenSpawning's creatures, and the item, villager, witch, crystal and dragon entities the build constructs, all folded into Rows.blkHash.

structs.name: SW_CLASS_NAME
structs.java: the Java class names the oracle dump spells for each SW_* kind

gpu: its former globals, function statics and lazily built tables are gone (lane/gpuenv, L2): per-environment state lives in struct env (csrc/engine/env.h), per-dimension state in the replay's dims, constant tables are built before main; csrc/tests/globals.sh lists what is left
line 90, function sw_new: realloc grows s->ents per constructed entity (heap growth, not a fixed-capacity array)
lines 371-373, function sw_top_block: while loop climbs y until an air block with no upper bound, and every read may generate a chunk
lines 695-710, function sw_spawn_position: fuzz loop bounded only by a 1000-iteration guard
lines 662-670 and 632-657, functions sw_on_chunk and sw_populate_chunk: indirect recursion, a populate call's feature reads load chunks through world.c, whose on_chunk hook reruns the populate rule
lines 754-772, function sw_init_shared: installs process-global hooks (populate_world_rand, populate_det, populate_on_ent, blockcb_env, randomtick and ticks.c globals) pointing into this struct
line 598, function sw_populate_end: writes the global spike_crystal_last report from features
lines 446-447, function sw_creatures: fprintf and abort on an unregistered biome id
struct seedworld holds pointer-based chunk storage (struct populate / world) and det split lists: a pointer graph the GPU cannot mirror as is
notes: Runs before the first tick for the standalone build, but serverreplay.c's sr_ensure_saved calls seedworld_init/seedworld_build (line 4922) lazily from a chunk load/unload callback during replay, so its cost and hazards can land inside a tick. Villager and witch records come from structure pieces via sw_sc_ent and are untested per the file's own comment (no seed of the five has one). Mineshaft chest minecarts are dropped (world.conf keeps minecarts off). Oracle references: out/java/seedworld/seed*/ (SpawnDump, SpawnDumpDim). Sheep fleece colour is written as the jr_int_n thresholds, not through EntitySheep.getRandomFleeceColor itself.
